name: Indonesia Women Half Marathon
short_description: A women-only 21.1 km half marathon in Indonesia. No date has been confirmed for the next edition, so this listing carries none.
ai_summary: The Indonesia Women Half Marathon is a women-only road race in Indonesia whose headline distance is the 21.1 km half marathon. The most recent edition its own listings confirm was held on 11 May 2025 at the Biomedical Campus in BSD City, alongside 5 km and 10 km options. A 2027 date appears on one international race calendar, but the organiser's own AIMS race entry still shows the 2025 event as its latest and no organiser announcement corroborates it, so no date is recorded here. The listing is kept and flagged rather than given a date nobody has published.
pros: Clear future race date already set (May 16, 2027)
Standard half marathon distance of 21.1 km
Takes place in Indonesia, accessible for regional runners
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
